description: RINGO was the first-generation fast-readout imaging polarimeter on the 2.0-meter Liverpool Telescope, using a rotating polaroid and prism with a broad VR hybrid filter (Schott GG475 + KG3).
short_description: Liverpool Telescope RINGO polarimeter, VR filter (GG475 + KG3)
facility_description: The Liverpool Telescope is a 2.0-meter fully robotic telescope operated by Liverpool John Moores University at Roque de los Muchachos Observatory on La Palma.
notes: RINGO was decommissioned in June 2009 and replaced by RINGO2 and later RINGO3. Its VR passband covers 460-720 nm using cemented Schott GG475 and KG3 filters. Downloaded materials are subject to the LJMU copyright policy restricting use to personal, non-commercial purposes. Observations should cite the Liverpool Telescope acknowledgement and instrument papers (Steele et al. 2004, 2006).
